title: Chapter 122 Reinforcements Arrive
content:
Chapter 122 Reinforcements Arrive

Boom!

The void in the distance cracked, and the next moment, a middle-aged man in a flaming robe slowly stepped out.

In just a moment, the temperature of the entire starry sky suddenly rose.

"It's the Emperor Yanyan of the Fire Spirit Star Domain!"

Seeing the middle-aged man, everyone in the Tianlin Star Domain exclaimed.

Wang Zhen in the distance also frowned slightly.

Obviously, this Emperor Yanyan is very powerful.

At this time, a huge breath suddenly surged out from the void crack behind Emperor Yanyan.

Boom!

Suddenly, a large number of strong men from the Fire Spirit Star Domain rushed out from it.

Seeing this scene, Luo Ming, the master of Tianlin Palace, immediately showed a barely perceptible smile.

Sure enough, they are here.

From this formation, it seems that Emperor Yanyan has brought all the elites of the Fire Spirit Star Domain.

In this case, their chances of winning are a little greater.

At this time, Emperor Yan Yan slowly came to the front of everyone in Tianlin Palace.

"Yan Yan, long time no see."

Looking at Emperor Yan Yan, Luo Ming smiled.

Hearing this, Emperor Yan Yan's face was cold, just snorted lightly, and slowly said: "Your abacus is really loud, I heard it in the Fire Spirit Star Region."

Hearing this, Luo Ming remained calm, "But you still came."

Dare you not come?

As long as I surrender now, the next target of the Divine Dynasty will be your Fire Spirit Star Region.

When that happens, you will have no place to cry.

Open conspiracy, absolutely open conspiracy!

Looking at the smugness in Luo Ming's eyes, Yan Yan directly chose to turn a blind eye.

Out of sight, out of mind.

Then Yan Yan turned his head to look at the army of the Divine Dynasty in the distance, and his expression gradually became cold.

"Damn Divine Dynasty, don't you fear retribution?"

Yan Yan said angrily.

He naturally hated the Divine Dynasty to the extreme.

In his eyes, the Divine Dynasty was an evil force with no limit to greed.

It had never done anything except invading other people's territory.

Hearing Yan Yan's angry roar, Wang Zhen said expressionlessly: "Don't you think that your Huoling Star Region and Tianlin Star Region can stop the Divine Dynasty by joining forces?"

If they really think so, they are really wrong.

At this moment, another cold voice sounded from the depths of the void.

"What if we add my Hun Gu Star Region?"

The next moment, the void cracked again.

I saw an old man in a black robe and several strong men slowly stepping out of the void crack.

The old man's aura was the same as that of Emperor Yan Yan.

They were all powerful Divine Emperors!

And behind him were the elite forces of the Hun Gu Star Region.

Hun Gu Star Domain, a powerful star domain that is no weaker than Huo Ling Star Domain, and even after these years of stable development, it is even stronger.

Seeing the powerful people in Hun Gu Star Domain, Luo Ming, the master of Tianlin Temple, had not had time to get excited when he heard a voice coming from behind.

"And my God of War Star Domain!"

Suddenly, a terrifying fighting spirit surged from the depths of the void.

The next moment, a middle-aged man wearing special armor appeared in front of everyone.

The strongest man in the God of War Star Domain, Tang Sheng!

Although Tang Sheng was alone, no one present dared to underestimate him.

Because in the past, the God of War Star Domain had once produced a God of War!

The fighting spirit was divine!

With his own strength, he raised the status of the God of War Star Domain infinitely.

Even though endless years have passed and the God of War Star Domain has long been lonely, the reputation of the God of War is still spread in countless star domains, shocking the heavens.

Looking at Tang Sheng who was full of vigor and vitality, Luo Ming said excitedly: "Brother Tang, have you, have you reached the level of god-level fighting spirit?"

The countless strong men present immediately stared at Tang Sheng intently.

Could it be that there is another god of war in the God of War Star Domain?

Tang Sheng showed a careful smile and said slowly: "Of course, no more."

Puff~

"Then what are you pretending for!!"

The Emperor Yan Yan said angrily.

You have the nerve to pretend even if you haven't reached the level of god-level fighting spirit.

Hearing this, Tang Sheng's smile suddenly stagnated, and then he coughed lightly and said: "Although my fighting spirit has not yet reached the level of god-level fighting spirit, it is not far away."

"It's more than enough to deal with these."

Tang Sheng pointed to the army of the Divine Dynasty and said confidently.

Hearing this, the people on the Tianlin Star Domain kept shaking their heads.

The Divine Dynasty is not so easy to deal with.

And at this moment, Wang Zhen's cold voice sounded.

"Have you said enough?"

All of a sudden, everyone turned their heads to look at Wang Zhen.

Wang Zhen suddenly shouted: "All troops, line up!"

Boom!

In an instant, the army of the Divine Dynasty changed its momentum, and the next moment, the entire army was like an indestructible spear, rushing straight towards the Tianlin Star Region.

Boom!

The explosion sounded throughout the world.

An invisible barrier slowly rose from the border of the Tianlin Star Region.

If it weren't for this barrier, the entire army of the Divine Dynasty would have marched straight in.

"Come again!"

Wang Zhen shouted again as if he had expected it.

Seeing this, everyone in the Tianlin Star Region was shocked.

"Not good, stop them!"

Although there was this natural barrier, they knew very well that this barrier alone was not enough to stop the army of the Divine Dynasty.

What's more, Wang Zhen and other Divine Dynasty leaders had not yet taken action.

As the army of the Divine Dynasty prepared for a second attack, the Tianlin Star Region could no longer sit still. Luo Ming, Yan Yan and others rushed out one after another.

The next moment, the battle was about to break out.

Countless magical skills were released crazily without regard for life. For a moment, the entire Divine Dynasty army suddenly began to stagnate.

Seeing this scene, Wang Zhen snorted coldly, and then said: "Follow me to meet the enemy!"

"Yes!"

Suddenly, several terrifying auras in the army rose to the sky.

Their strengths were not weaker than the Divine Emperor Realm.

Among them, Wang Zhen's strength was the strongest, and the combat power of the peak of the Divine Emperor Realm was almost unstoppable!

Seeing Wang Zhen so fierce, Luo Ming and others looked a little ugly.

Just when everyone was at a loss, Tang Sheng stood up.

"Wang Zhen, your opponent is me!"

After blasting away countless Divine Dynasty strongmen with a punch, Tang Sheng immediately rushed to Wang Zhen and blocked Wang Zhen's way.

"Come, let me see if the so-called God Dynasty generals are as terrifying as the rumors say."

According to rumors, there are a total of twelve God Generals in the God Dynasty.

The weakest among them have the strength of the God Emperor Realm, and they are the kind without any water. Each God General is one in a million.

And Wang Zhen, among the twelve God Generals, his strength is not even in the top five.

So at this moment, Tang Sheng was a little arrogant. He was just a second-rate God General. Could it be that he, the future God of War, could not be his opponent?

Thinking of this, Tang Sheng's fighting spirit became more and more surging, and the long spear in his hand pointed at Wang Zhen.

"Come and fight!"

Seeing this, Wang Zhen sneered, and there was no extra nonsense.

"As you wish."

The next moment, Wang Zhen's figure rushed towards Tang Sheng.
